name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Hands of Destruction) — 2 Intermediate — Acidic Touch

system.description:
The sorcerer's vitae curdles into a thick, black, bilious acid that burns flesh, cloth, metal and wood alike wherever their coated hands make contact.

No test is needed to create the acid, which you may exude from any part of your body, so even a touch or a kiss can be deadly. It inflicts one health level of aggravated damage per application and can eat through most substances (Storyteller's discretion for time), so you may need several turns to burn through a stubborn target. To strike a person you must win the normal Physical Challenge to hit. The acid is thick and slimy and cannot be thrown or spat; it must be delivered by touch. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
